comment: Read from the source at tag v2.1.14 (commit 75e5f70), which is the installed build. Input 3 (TRIGGER, named Gate) is configured but has no PortWidget and is never read, so it gets no line, no tag and no props. Param 14 (Dephase Algorithm) likewise has no widget; it is reachable only from the panel menu and is covered by a Menu line. The maker's page says setting an OCTAVE knob to Off disables that LFO; in the code calcVOctFreq returns 1.f for a negative octave under the Old dephase algorithm, which leaves that axis turning at 1Hz, and 0.f under the New one. Under the New algorithm a Z octave below zero also forces the Z LFO influence to a fixed 0.95 (line 325). The three ROTATION jacks are given no range because the knob they add to runs 0 to 100 and the sum is never clamped, so no single voltage span is the fact.
